title: DC-area forecast: Fairly comfortable and seasonable as we wind down July
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Clouds that popped up during the day are with us through evening but diminish into the night. Relatively pleasant with 70s taking over this evening and 60s for lows.

What’s next? A touch toastier to close out July on Friday with highs in the mid-80s to near 90. Similar temperatures into early next week. Rain chances could return by Sunday.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: After a slight chance of an early-evening raindrop, mostly cloudy skies early trend mainly clear overnight. Evening readings falling into the 70s settle to lows across the 60s. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Friday): More sun than not, but humidity stays tolerable with dew points still around 60. We see July off right – near average highs in the mid-80s to around 90. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Another pleasant evening for out and about activities. Mainly mid-60s to near 70 for lows. Confidence: Medium-High

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Perhaps a touch warmer for Saturday, but still mainly mid-80s to near 90. There's an outside shot at a late-day shower or storm. Confidence: Medium

A bit higher chance for some showers, maybe a thunderstorm, at some point on Sunday, which also means more clouds. Otherwise, still floating around near normal for temperatures with highs in the mid- and upper 80s. Confidence: Medium

More bubbling summertime conditions into the early workweek. Nothing extreme, but daily highs aren't far from 90 and an afternoon storm chance for Monday and Tuesday. Confidence: Medium

Disastrous flooding in Ellicott City

Catastrophic flooding in 2016 inundated Ellicott City after an extraordinary burst of rainfall, triggering rescues and widespread destruction.

Today’s daily digit — 7/10: Very sunny through at least midday and not too humid. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.
